result:
I fixed all three problems; the 57 tests under `tests/server` pass.

1. **Switching off didn't save** (`src/server/repositories/webhook-repository.ts`): `updateEndpoint` only wrote `enabled` when the new value was `true`, so switching an endpoint off never saved. It now writes `enabled` whenever a value is given, so switching off and back on both work. The code that queues events already skipped switched-off endpoints; it just never saw one because the switch-off never saved.
2. **Old deliveries still went out** (`src/server/jobs/webhook-delivery-job.ts`): the delivery run now marks a queued delivery as failed ("endpoint is disabled") when its endpoint is switched off. It already failed deliveries whose endpoint no longer exists. Both count as failed, and deliveries to endpoints that are on go out as before.
3. **Allowance check** (`src/server/services/webhook-service.ts`): `createWebhook` now counts every endpoint with the existing `countEndpoints`, not just the ones that are on. A workspace at its limit can no longer create another endpoint by switching one off first.
